offline.title: Offline review
offline.policy: Prepare 10 text/choice prompts online, valid 24 hours (20 per account). Keep this signed-in tab open offline. Sync uses server grading and suggested ratings; only receipts count. No hints or media.
offline.failure: Storage/sync failed. Answers are not completed. Retry online; keep browser data for recovery.
offline.empty: No saved prompts (possibly evicted). Prepare online again; leases cannot be extended.
offline.discardWarning: Delete this device's prompt/answer only? Server receipts remain. Unconfirmed answers do not count. Copy first if needed.

recovery.failed: Unconfirmed. Retry online with the saved retry identity.
recovery.expired: Expired: saved, not graded. Copy/discard, then prepare online.
recovery.stale: Card changed/unavailable: answer saved. Copy/discard, then prepare online.

pwa.installDescription: Open PandaWords from your home screen. Learning still requires a connection.
pwa.installFailed: Installation couldn't start. You can continue using PandaWords in your browser.

relations.title: Personal semantic links
relations.policy: Choose a visible selected sense. Links are directional and require two different senses. Source links are read-only.
relations.noCandidates: Search your selected vocabulary or your own senses.
relations.choose: Choose a different target sense before creating a link.
relations.invalid: Check the selected senses and relation type, then try again.
relations.duplicate: This personal link already exists. No duplicate was created.
relations.confirmRemove: Remove this personal link? Source links will not change.
relations.failed: Could not complete the request. Your selection is kept; retry loading, creating or removing the link.

reading.title: Reading
reading.chooseProject: Choose a project to add this sense.
reading.empty: No passages yet. Paste a passage to start reading.
reading.failed: Unable to load or save. Your draft is kept; retry.
reading.unavailable: This passage or project is unavailable. Return to the library or choose another project.
reading.legend: Highlighted: visible selected sense. Dotted underline: linked but outside this selection. Plain: unlinked. Select any word to look it up.
reading.outside: Linked, but not visible in this project
reading.explicit: Choose the intended lemma and sense explicitly. Lookup never selects a meaning for you.
reading.noCandidates: No dictionary candidates. Try another lemma; the passage is unchanged.
reading.addFailed: Add or link failed. Your selection is kept. Retry completes any unfinished link without adding another sense.

graph.title: Graph
graph.filtersHint: No selected filters means all types. Arrows show relation direction.
graph.bounded: Explore up to 300 nodes, at most three steps from one focus. Only visible project vocabulary and your own content are available.
graph.empty: No visible vocabulary on this page. Try another search or add words to a project.
graph.choose: Choose a word to load its neighborhood.
graph.error: The graph is unavailable. Try again or choose another focus.
graph.tooLarge: This neighborhood is too large. Reduce depth or narrow node and relation filters.

tags.title: Tags
tags.name: Tag name
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag and all your assignments to and from it? Other content is kept.
tags.failed: Tags could not be updated or loaded. Your choices are kept; retry the action or reload.
tags.cycle: This parent would create a cycle. Choose another tag.
tags.protected: This tag has protected memberships and cannot be deleted.

phrases.composition: These are phrase components, not evidence that a particular word sense is used literally.
phrases.empty: No materialized phrases contain this word.
phrases.noProjects: Create a project first, then return to add this phrase.

images.title: Private sense images
images.limits: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; up to 10 MiB, 25 million pixels per frame, 100 frames and 50 million pixels total.
images.removeConfirm: Remove only your private attachment? This cannot be undone.
images.disabled: Pixabay search is not configured. You can still upload an image.
images.rateLimit: The image provider or download queue is busy. Wait before retrying.
images.error: Image operation failed. Upload remains available without Pixabay. Check the image or provider configuration and retry.

mnemonics.privacy: Only this target's dictionary text is sent to DeepSeek. Notes and personal overrides are not sent. Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
mnemonics.loading: Preparing a suggestion. You can keep editing or cancel.
mnemonics.replaceConfirm: Your unsaved mnemonic text will be replaced. The suggestion remains editable and is not saved automatically.
mnemonics.unavailable: Suggestions are disabled or unavailable. You can still write and save your own mnemonic.
mnemonics.budget: The daily suggestion budget is exhausted. You can still edit manually; try again tomorrow.
mnemonics.timeout: The suggestion timed out. Your draft is unchanged. Retry when ready.
mnemonics.provider: The suggestion could not be prepared. Your draft is unchanged. Please retry.
mnemonics.stale: This target has changed or is no longer available. Refresh it before requesting another suggestion.

session.title: Project review
session.leaveDescription: Your attempt is kept in this browser tab. Unconfirmed answers do not update your schedule. Return to this project to resume or retry an uncertain request.
session.restart: Reload queue and start a fresh attempt
session.emptyDescription: The current queue is empty. Daily limits, due times and project visibility determine what is available.
session.audioUnavailable: Audio unavailable. Retry playback, give up, or exit; no answer is revealed.
session.imagePrompt: Type the word shown in the image.
session.mediaNotice: Changes apply to new exercises only. You can still finish an exercise already in progress.
session.timing: Answer time: {duration} ms · Server elapsed: {elapsed} ms

errors.recoverable: The request could not be completed. Retry safely; a pending answer or rating will be sent unchanged.
errors.unusable: No usable exercise is available for this card. Nothing was skipped or graded. Retry after adding suitable content, or exit.
errors.expired: This attempt has expired. Reload the queue to start a fresh attempt; no unconfirmed answer updates your schedule.
errors.stale: This attempt conflicts with the latest study state. Reload the queue instead of applying an outdated answer.
errors.unavailable: This attempt or project content is no longer available. Check project access and visibility, then reload the queue.
errors.storage: This tab cannot safely save the review session. Enable session storage and retry before continuing.
errors.hintUnavailable: No hint is available for this exercise. You can still answer or give up.

study.utcNotice: Daily limits and history use UTC dates. Forecasts include overdue cards today and existing scheduled reviews only, not simulated future reviews. Dashboard totals deduplicate shared cards; project counts can overlap.
study.examPacing: {remaining} new senses · {days} study windows left · suggested {suggested}/day. Capacity: {capacity}; capacity before the 7-day buffer: {buffer}.
study.examPast: The exam time has passed. Choose a future exam date or clear it.
study.examImpossible: The remaining new senses cannot fit before the exam at the current daily limit.
study.examBuffer: The seven-day revision buffer is at risk. Consider adjusting the plan.
study.emptyDescription: Create a project and select some senses to start learning.
study.zeroLimit: A zero limit pauses that category; a blank review cap is unlimited.
study.queueEmpty: No cards ready in this plan
study.queueEmptyDescription: You may have reached today's limits, have no selected senses, or be waiting for the next scheduled review.
study.retentionHelp: Enter a number strictly between 0 and 1, for example 0.9 for 90%.
study.retentionNotice: This setting applies to your future scheduling across all projects. Saving it does not rewrite existing cards or review history.
study.retentionValidation: Enter a finite number greater than 0 and less than 1.
study.orderNotice: Load all visible selected senses in project-tree order to create a new priority draft. This is not a readback of saved priority. Saving replaces the visible priority order, including senses outside today's capped queue. Already learned senses stay learned; hidden slots are preserved by the server.

exercise.choiceShortcuts: Focus choices: 1–4 select, Enter submits. H requests a hint outside text fields. Escape requests exit. Space on the exercise frame requests audio.
exercise.typedShortcuts: Enter submits. Type normally in the answer field (including H and Space). Escape outside text fields requests exit.
exercise.ratingShortcuts: Focus ratings: 1–4 select, Enter or Space confirms.

preview.recall: Typed recall · incorrect feedback and rating override
preview.simulation: Preview only: fixed feedback simulates a server response; production components never grade answers.
